parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Green Retro Vision (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.24 */
parameter.description: A recreation of an effect from the game Minecraft that shows how a Creeper sees.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines which color will be the basis for modification. Set to 0 means it will be the texture of the object and set to 1 it will be the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Color Light
parameter.description: Determines what color should be used when brightness is at its highest.

parameter.name: Color Shadow
parameter.description: Determines what color should be used when lightness is at its lowest.
